facts.text: El Palace Barcelona is a 5-star hotel originally born as The Ritz.
facts.excerpt: A luxury 5-star hotel originally born as The Ritz, thoughtfully reimagined for today

facts.text: The hotel is just steps from Passeig de Gracia.
facts.excerpt: Just steps from Passeig de Gràcia, the hotel offers refined rooms and suites

facts.text: The hotel's restaurant Amar Barcelona is by chef Rafa Zafra.
facts.excerpt: Discover Amar Barcelona by chef Rafa Zafra

facts.text: The Rooftop Garden offers panoramic views, and the hotel has a Mayan-inspired spa.
facts.excerpt: take in panoramic views from the Rooftop Garden, unwind in the serene Mayan-inspired spa

facts.text: The hotel serves an Afternoon Tea in the British style.
facts.excerpt: The authentic Afternoon Tea in the purest British style.

facts.text: El Jardin is the hotel's breakfast garden.
facts.excerpt:
THE BREAKFAST GARDEN

## El Jardín

facts.text: The Ronnie Wood suite is an Art Deco suite that was once home to Rolling Stones guitarist Ronnie Wood.
facts.excerpt: This Art Deco suite was once home to Rolling Stones guitarist Ronnie Wood.

facts.text: Art Suites and El Palace Suites come with private check-in airport transfer, butler service and a champagne welcome.
facts.excerpt:
- Private check in airport transfer

- Butler service

- Champagne welcome

facts.text: Art Suites and El Palace Suites are offered with one or two bedrooms, each with a separate living and dining area.
facts.excerpt: Each Art Suite features a separate living and dining area. The two-bedroom configuration includes an additional bathroom

facts.text: Classic Rooms have an original 1919 fireplace chosen by Cesar Ritz for the hotel's first design.
facts.excerpt: An original feature, chosen by César Ritz for the hotel’s first design.

facts.text: Classic Rooms have full soundproofing and open onto a French balcony with city views.
facts.excerpt: Expansive city views and full soundproofing ensure total tranquility in these light-filled rooms, opening onto a French balcony.

facts.text: Junior Suites, Superior Suites and Deluxe Suites overlook the inner courtyard of the Eixample.
facts.excerpt: Windows overlook the inner courtyard of the Eixample, adding a quieter atmosphere.

facts.text: The Art Suites have an original Roman-style bathroom from 1919, restored in each suite.
facts.excerpt: Art Suites feature an original Roman-style bathroom from 1919, restored in each suite.

facts.text: The Salvador Dali suite preserves the original decor from Dali's stays at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: This suite preserves the original décor from Dalí’s stays at El Palace Barcelona

facts.text: Salvador Dali was a frequent client of the hotel in the 1970s and photographed models in the Roman bath now in his suite.
facts.excerpt: Salvador Dalí was a frequent client of the hotel during the decade of the 1970s. During that time, he photographed models in the same Roman bath that is in the suite today.

facts.text: Dali once sent a taxidermied white horse up the hotel's main staircase as a birthday present for his wife Gala.
facts.excerpt: he sent a taxidermied white horse up the main staircase of the hotel to the room where he was staying with his wife, Gala, presenting it to her as a birthday present.

facts.text: Joan Miro was a regular at the hotel, then known as the Ritz of Barcelona, in the 1970s.
facts.excerpt: Joan Miró was a regular at El Palace Barcelona, then known as the Ritz of Barcelona, in the 1970s.

facts.text: The Joan Miro Art Suite is known as the Golden Suite.
facts.excerpt: Known as the Golden Suite, it reflects the vibrant colours loved by Joan Miró.

facts.text: The Three-Bedroom Family Suite combines two Junior Suites and one Single Room connected by a private corridor.
facts.excerpt: Bringing together two Junior Suites and one Single Room, this three-bedroom suite is connected by a private corridor

facts.text: Children's amenities, including a children's teepee, are available on request in the Three-Bedroom Family Suite.
facts.excerpt: Children’s teepee upon request

facts.text: Politician Francesc Cambo insisted Barcelona needed a first-class hotel like the Ritz in Madrid, with the 1929 International Exposition pending.
facts.excerpt: Francesc Cambó, a politician and intellectual, insisted that Barcelona needed to have a first-class hotel, like the Ritz in Madrid. This was especially important with events like the 1929 Barcelona International Exposition pending.

facts.text: Accessible Junior Suites are available on request.
facts.excerpt: Accessible Junior Suites available upon request

facts.text: The Carlos Ruiz Zafon suite is inspired by the writer who captured Barcelona and this hotel in his novels.
facts.excerpt: A suite inspired by the writer who captured Barcelona and this hotel in his novels.
